title: Demon Arena
core_verb: Shoot demons while moving through the arena to reduce the enemy count to zero.
fantasy: A lone armored fighter trapped in an enclosed demonic combat arena with six hostile demons, weapon pickups, and a sealed exit.
fail_state: Player health reaches zero from demon attacks or contact.
win_state: Kill all six demons so the enemy count reaches zero, then cross the unlocked exit threshold.

interaction_tags.meaning: Hostile enemy; attacks and contact reduce player health, and killing one decreases the arena enemy count.
Single-use pickup that restores 25 armor and 10 ammunition.
Sealed goal doorway that unlocks when the enemy count reaches zero; crossing its threshold wins.

notes: DOOM Eternal is reduced to one enclosed single-player arena containing exactly six demons, one pickup class, and one exit; campaign traversal, upgrades, glory kills, and additional encounters are omitted.

scene.description: An enclosed stone arena lit by flickering torches and a red-orange glow from cracks in the floor. Thick square pillars break sight lines, demon spawn points ring the edges, weapon pickups glow green on wall racks, and a sealed iron gate marks the exit. Iron chains and skull decorations dress the walls; moderate clutter, so there is cover to use but open lanes to fight across.
